node.statement: Assuming the compatibility obligation in node 1.3, let M be any compact C^1 manifold and choose the class-one allowable atlas supplied there. Node 1.1 then gives a finite cover of M by domains of allowable coordinate systems; node 1.2, using GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549, gives that M is homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex. Since M was arbitrary, this is the root conclusion.
